notes.title: The 1.5 Galactic Summer Update Has Arrived!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Massive Limited-time Demo + Galactic Summer[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/5e44d5684b82fef4e385068e093f30145b01a44d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Some universe-shaking news for fans and their frog-curious friends: we’re bringing back the Entropy Survivors demo and[i] it’s going to be huge[/i].[/p][p] [/p][p]This new free demo offers the first three worlds of the game, a sample of classes and weapons, and half of Entropy Survivors’ 48 in-game abilities. There’s genuinely hours upon hours of content here—so much so that our publisher has asked us to make the demo available for just a few weeks. Snag it now while you can![/p][p][/p][p]This revamped demo is totally compatible with the full game in online multiplayer! Returning players can now bring their demo-owning friends along with them as they cut and blast their way through the game’s missions and remixes, and vice-versa.[/p][p][/p][p]Can’t stop playing? Unlock the full game and seamlessly bring over your demo progress to keep Froggie and GERM’s adventures going.

[/p][h3][b]Galactic Summer Event[/b][/h3][p]It’s summer in the northern hemisphere, [u]which means it's also summer in outer space[/u]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/b707117b3434221c95c89dd0905eeb7c3fb8503b.png"][/img][/p][p]For players old and new alike, we’ve got a festive Galactic Summer event running for the next few weeks. Catch some rays on the sandless beaches of the Entropy Survivors hub and win some missions to unlock this sunny Beach dye or the refreshing Watermelon skin.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/7e5f21a3c2b0d75e4456d99e574e9fd0702d6ba5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/85e35903a15d175f00ae22bb776a05c3c372a673.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]In addition to the massive new limited-time demo and the Galactic Summer event, the Entropy Survivors 1.5 update also features minor bugfixes and other improvements. Full patch notes to come.[/p][p]-Moving Pieces[/p]

notes.title: The 1.4 Challenge Update Is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Entropy Survivors 1.4 Challenge Update Has Arrived![/h1]

This update includes a swath of [b]new challenges[/b] (our in-game “quests”) geared toward endless and other high-level players.

These new challenges offer extra sources of skill tree gold to endgame players along with some fresh new skill-based challenges for beginner and veteran players alike.

In addition to the extra gold, these challenges unlock some of our favorite [b]dyes[/b] yet:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/8059ebb337f4f6f0c59bf0f6d5c3e08fd7ca38ab.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/5bfd8c66c1ea3e1930770dd08a609a9b0997c2d0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/a6c737cbdaf001a93d2bd24671c6b38976d1e357.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/850fded147f053be554232d5c448cbb7ad00fa65.png[/img]

To celebrate the 1.4 Challenge Update, Entropy Survivors is on sale for 30% off from now until April 28th!

Best of luck, Survivors!

[h1]St Patrick’s Spring Event - Update 1.3[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/144a362e25b8ae8ae163ee27b01ed3512ceb18b7.jpg[/img]

This month our team celebrates our proud Irish-American heritage with an in-game St. Patrick’s Day event! Come and see what exclusive dyes await you at the end of the rainbow:

notes.title: 1.2.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
FIX: Heroes standing in two overlapping Enchanter sigils no longer lose the sigil effect early
FIX: Multiple rocket launcher performance improvements
FIX: Fixed bug allowing multiple copies of the mission select menu to be open at once
FIX: Reconfigured memory management to avoid CPU-heavy memory operations in the middle of combat
UPDATE: Endless leaderboards show more players.
UPDATE: The game now saves hourly automatic backups to [b]%LOCALAPPDATA%/EntropySurvivors/Saved/SaveGames/LocalBackups[/b]. We do not believe there are any save-losing bugs in the Entropy Survivors game code, however accidents are always possible with conflicting cloud saves, hardware failures, full disks, and so on, so we wanted to give players an emergency backup option. These backups are not synced to Steam's cloud.

notes.title: Endless Missions, Trading Cards, Lunar New Year, & Pirate Software Interview
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Lunar New Year![/h1]

Ring in the Year of the Snake with a new challenge mode, trading cards, and new Lunar New Year-themed content.

[b]Endless Missions[/b]! Players looking for a never-ending set of challenges can now play procedurally remixed levels ad infinitum. The new Endless Missions portal opens up midway through the game and provides an increasingly difficult parade of new missions to conquer. How far can you get?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/a69ab100f0f97d8e8ac164cbd9e981e9ab4bf24c.png[/img]

[b]Trading Cards[/b]! Steam trading cards are here at last! Cards, badges, profile backgrounds, emoticons, the works! Collect'm all! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/96091c7c02a2826c7b528067b9040c18454dac81.jpg[/img]

[b]Lunar New Year[/b]! Welcome the Year of the Snake in style with lantern decorations throughout the game’s hub along with two new limited-time unlockable dyes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/cfaf3a98d2498e1e8f5f06d1abe8de1da0ac0524.png[/img]

[b]Endless Mission Leaderboards[/b]. Compete with your fellow Survivors to see who can beat the toughest planets the multiverse has to offer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/de4cf3545dbd35d3f1141f2ca43ef5e183af1114.png[/img]

[b]Brand new unlockable dyes and perk point challenges[/b] for beating Endless Missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/6fa28f24615d4bcef0ef19b1fa32628b67ed83df.png[/img]

[b]Mission History[/b]! The Chameleon has built a cute little robot in the hub that lets you check the results of previous missions. Beat a mission on World 2 to unlock it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/6bfc69cee965cc09702ae0e11a4d7d0a3ebbb7e9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/940d679210c9e0630619932acbfee2a967f0f2c3.png[/img]

You can now [b]exchange collectibles for gold[/b] within a new menu on the skill tree! This is meant to support endgame play and is unlocked the first time you roll credits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/c1df62d83dd5eb94b5fbebe1eea5ce5e81576a1f.png[/img]

[h1]Pirate Software Interview[/h1]

[url=piratesoftware.live][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/b0a1c56e4a6f1d3c42db7a6babfc78905416425b.jpg[/img][/url]

We are excited to announce that we will be participating in a Dev Interview on January 31st at 9:00 AM Pacific, hosted by the legendary [b]Pirate Software.[/b] First Break Labs has teamed up with Pirate Software in their charity drive benefiting [url=https://www.humanesociety.org/]The Humane Society[/url]. Friday's interview is in support of the Pirate Software charity stream, and we will discuss the development behind Entropy Survivors indepth! Watch us using the link below at 9:00 AM Pacific!

[url=piratesoftware.live]piratesoftware.live[/url]


Last but not least, we're excited to announce that Entropy Survivors is on sale for 20% off for Lunar New Years, from January 29th to February 10th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/9c7de52532a81a0e6bc921640880a384497665d0.jpg[/img]

This patch also features dozens of performance improvements, balance changes, and bugfixes.

notes.title: 1.2.1 Full Update Notes
notes.content:
NEW - Endless Missions! Players looking for a never-ending set of challenges can now play procedurally remixed levels ad infinitum. The new Endless Missions portal opens up midway through the game and provides an increasingly difficult parade of new missions to conquer. How far can you get?

NEW - Endless Leaderboards. Compete with your fellow Survivors to see who can beat the toughest planets the multiverse has to offer.

NEW - Brand new unlockable dyes and perk point challenges related to Endless Missions.

NEW - Mission History! The Chameleon has built a cute little robot in the hub that lets you check the results of previous mission. Beat a mission on World 2 to unlock it.

NEW - Lunar New Year! Welcome the Year of the Snake in style with lantern decorations around the game along with two new limited-time unlockable dyes.

NEW - You can now exchange collectibles for gold within a new menu on the skill tree! This is meant to support endgame play and is unlocked the first time you roll credits.

FIXED - Many performance improvements related to player projectiles

FIXED - Many performance improvements related to the Army class

FIXED - It is no longer possible for a host's auto attack setting to cause clients to attack when they're standing still

FIXED - Cleaned up some ground objects that could cause players to get stuck

FIXED - Removed/simplified multiple particle systems that were proving problematic for some graphics cards

BALANCE - Pieces of gold drop half as frequently in missions but are worth twice as much. This reduces the visual clutter and physics overhead without changing the amount of gold you collect over the course of a mission.

BALANCE - Many skills in the skill tree have much, much higher level caps to support endgame play.

notes.title: Entropy Survivors - 1.1.0 Holiday Auto-Attack Update
notes.content:
[h1]Holiday Auto-attack Update[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/8c03707efdd23bfc2c68cb47f0adcf3dc6cf6301.png[/img]

Hello, frog-and-robot fans! We’re excited to announce our first major update for Entropy Survivors is out today: The 1.1.0 Holiday Auto-attack Update.

We’ve been listening to your feedback these last two weeks and working extra hard to put together your two most requested features:

- Additional options for configuring how you control your attacks/switch characters.
- More holiday cheer, decked halls, boughs of holly, etc.


First and foremost, this update makes classic survivors-style controls possible with additional auto-attack options. We know many of you expect to be able to play a game like this with fewer inputs and are doing our best to give everyone the bullet heaven experience they expect without altering the core of the game. 

In 1.1.0, enabling auto-attack allows for two new options:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/dd32610cbf72796631ce74aba612f5bc5c632636.png[/img]

One option lets you swap between melee and ranged modes at a click of a button, rather than pressing or holding. The other option will automatically switch to ranged attacks whenever ammo is available, letting you skip the button press entirely!

Some additional presents: Keyboard players can now select upgrades using the 1,2, or 3 keys to make the game easier to play without a mouse. Controller players using auto-aim can temporarily override it at any time by moving the right analog stick, giving you instant control whenever you need it.

On the non-control front: it’s time to celebrate Winter in outer space (don’t think about it too hard). Until January 1st, Entropy Survivors is running a Winter holiday event. For a limited time, enjoy some festive decorations in the hub and main menu (if this is all humbug to you: yes, it can be disabled in the settings menu).


The Winter event also features two limited-time unlockable dyes with holiday flare. Get them now and and show off these candy-coated ensembles all year long:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/a19e10ac3f4d0b62117a29a07556e0ae27fafa85.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698974/daa6bed9431fa8825f15819bbc76dcc599a228e1.png[/img]


And of course this patch comes with other smaller changes and fixes. For the full patch notes please look below. We can’t wait to show you what else we’ve been cooking up in the new year!

UPDATE: Added a special event for the winter solstice with decorations and two unlockable dyes.

UPDATE: Added multiple new auto-attack options.

UPDATE: Controller players can use the right stick temporarily override auto-aim

UPDATE: Keyboard players can choose upgrades using the 1,2, and 3 keys. Prompts are shown for these when using auto-aim, but they also work even if auto-aim is disabled.

UPDATE: On-screen pick-ups (XP, Gold, etc) at the end of a mission are evenly split between players in a co-op game so as to not skew multiplayer awards.

FIX: Added a check to automatically reposition players who are "stuck"

FIX: Updated the description of the Fog of War Assassin perk to better convey that it triggers on enemies *inside* the smoke, rather than the player being inside the smoke.

FIX: Players who go off-screen during multiplayer should no longer be teleported into a bad position

FIX: Added extra safety checks to the Paladin's Cleansing Shield

FIX: Enchanter projectile boosts no longer apply to an entire convoy of trash trucks.

FIX: Turrets ignore invulnerable or hacked units.

FIX: Added an extra accessibility option to make some text larger.

BALANCE: Shogun class skill now applies to bosses

BALANCE: Increased aiming speed default value to 50% of normal move speed from 45%.

BALANCE: Bubbled enemies no longer have collision with player abilities.

BALANCE: Tuning fork is now placed further in front of the player and never inside walls.

BALANCE: Shogun's Butterfly Blade perk restores more health but has a random activation chance per enemy.

BALANCE: Fog of War perk covers a smaller area.

BALANCE: Tuning forks frequency decreased, and damage decreased

BALANCE: Hack - Increased number of enemies hacked

BALANCE: Shields Skate perk has a slower speed

BALANCE: Domino punch does more damage

BALANCE: Blink duration increased

BALANCE: Unstable Anomaly has increased damage

BALANCE: Autocannon does less damage at higher upgrade levels

BALANCE: Increased Shogun Class Robot Damage boost

BALANCE: Bombing run bombs drop further behind player

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
Thanks everyone so much for the bug reports and feedback. We've made the following changes in this latest update:

- UPDATE: We've added a highly-requested in-game toggle for auto-aim. We know this doesn't fit everyone's perfect playstyle and we are working toward an even larger set of aim/fire options to accommodate everyone as elegantly as we can. Please let us know what you think in this Steam thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2602030/discussions/0/604141771964862053/
- UPDATE: Players automatically collect onscreen currency after completing a mission for increased "fun" and "joy."
- UPDATE: Rewrote camera tracking code to more smoothly transition between "centered" and "rubber-banding" multiplayer views. Basically if you're moving around a lot in co-op you should no longer feel a pop or hitch from the camera.
- FIX: Added a cap to the number of times a pickup can be duplicated with the Mirror perk on the Shogun.
- FIX: Fixed a couple more abilities that became pathologically overpowered with the Enchanter class skill
- FIX: Updated internal SDKs that could possibly fix some rare stability issues with network connections
- FIX: Removed a shader from the Jet class skill that randomly caused crashes on a small set of GPUs
- FIX: Toggling the in-game challenge view by clicking the button no longer steals the space bar focus, preventing players from dodging.
- FIX: Added an extra layer of redundancy so that players don't miss out on upgrades due to dropped packets on the network.

notes.title: Major Batch of Changes and Fixes
notes.content:
Hi all! I'll cut to the chase here. These are the major fixes and changes now in the Entropy Survivors demo:

[h2]Reworks to the Nature Idol Class🍃[/h2] 
The Nature class (IMO) has some of the coolest perks in the game, but the base class ability just wasn't strong enough. To make it more powerful and juicy while keeping the core mechanic of "putting up walls" the same, we've done the following:
[list]
[*] Players now have an attribute called "thorn damage" that does damage over time to any enemies touching you. 
[*] The Nature class has a base thorn damage amount, and thorn damage effects also apply to any enemies touching your roots. Now your corralled foes will helplessly lose health as they struggle to reach you!
[*] Any players touching your roots get a flat armor and speed buff.
[/list]


[h2]Visual Changes🎥[/h2]
Mostly small changes to improve CPU usage and readability, but some standouts:
[list]
[*] Damage numbers are now colored/sized differently depending on context. Damage to players is red. Crits are orange-yellow.
[*] The rock wall and trash truck abilities block less of the play area from view.
[*] Fixed a goofy little hole in the bottom of the desert level.
[/list] 

[h2]Technical Fixes💾[/h2]
Anyone who submits a crash report when the crash reporter comes up is the real MVP.
[list]
[*] Fixed an extremely bad issue where enemies more-or-less permanently stop spawning for players that moved quickly around the level.
[*] Enemies are no longer spawned in the center of the level if an error occurs while placing them.
[*] We are aware of a very annoying, random-ish multiplayer-only crash bug that seems to happen near the end of mission. Unfortunately this one has been really complicated to track down, as the crash happens inside the Unreal Engine garbage collection code. I've just pushed a possible fix (again, this isn't reproducible in our office) as well as some additional crash logging information. If this is happening to you regularly, please get in touch!
[/list] 

Thanks again for all the feedback and for spending your valuable time with our game!
-Kyle

notes.title: The Demo is Live!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to share this first look at Entropy Survivors with you. 

We’re eager to hear if you think it’s fun too! This demo contains the following:

[list]
[*] 3 classes to try, each with their own activatable skills and unique attributes
[*] 4 equippable weapons to radically switch up your playstyle
[*] 28 unlockable class- and weapon-modifying perks that add powerful and, frankly, absurd new mechanics to your arsenal
[*] A slice of our extremely video-gamey skill tree
[*] 20+ abilities to collect and upgrade during your run
[*] A preview of our “desert” planet, with three missions of different difficulty
[*] Fully functional online co-op!
[/list]

This game started as a tiny internal experiment in the tiny office of our tiny indie studio. We wanted to see how many Shoulders of Giants enemies we could get working on screen in a networked co-op game. With a few days of heavily optimizing (read: deleting large swaths of) Unreal Engine’s movement code, we were startled both by how much we could have going on with 4 players on the network, and by how fun it was.

Be sure to fill out the in-game feedback form or join us on Discord to share your thoughts. Entropy Survivors is still in the midst of full development and we’re not afraid of making changes in response to criticism; your candid feedback will sharpen us into a fine katana blade.

Welcome to Entropy Survivors.
